data.name: Wangala
data.note: 100 Drums Wangala — post-harvest thanksgiving festival of the Garo people of Meghalaya. Dedicated to Misi Saljong (Sun God). Features the iconic 100-drum ensemble, Doke Mande (slow dance) and Chambil Mande (fast dance).
data.notice: Festival observance may vary by region and tradition.
